name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE near 97.5 on 25 Nov, just under the 100 line; US 10-year yield 4.85%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 97.5 on 25 Nov, below the 100 Watch line but 40% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 4.85%, about 20bp lower on the month and inside the 40bp line (Yahoo Finance). The data floor keeps Watch while MOVE sits just below the boundary; no disorderly auction or emergency Fed action was found.
for_you: US government bond prices are moving more than usual, which can feed through to mortgage and borrowing rates linked to Treasury yields.
rubric_hit: MOVE 95.3 has not yet cleared the 90 exit line, so Watch holds

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofA MOVE Index (^MOVE)

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
